title: Velvety Mexican Mackerel Tamales
description: A creamy, cultured dish featuring mackerel in a nimono-simmered sauce wrapped in corn husks for a solo dinner option.
instructions: Prepare the corn husks by soaking them in hot water for at least an hour.
Clean and scale the mackerel, then score its skin lightly with a sharp knife.
Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onions, garlic, red bell pepper, and spices (cumin, coriander, chili powder) to sauté until softened.
Add canned tomatoes, rice vinegar, dijon mustard, chicken broth, coconut milk, mackerel, cilantro, and salt to the pan. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until thickened.
Roll each corn husk around a piece of mackerel and place in a steamer basket lined with cheesecloth.
Steam the tamales covered for approximately 15-20 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Serve hot as a solo dinner dish.
